title: Private Full Day Mount Baker and North Cascades Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning landscapes of Washington State on a full-day tour from Seattle to Mount Baker and North Cascades National Park. Begin your adventure at the Mount Baker viewpoint, soaking in panoramic views of majestic mountains and lush valleys. Capture the beauty of Nooksack Falls, a breathtaking waterfall nestled in a serene forest canyon. Continue to Picture Lake, famous for its tranquil waters that mirror the iconic Mount Baker. Finally, explore the vibrant hues of Diablo Lake, surrounded by impressive alpine scenery, making this journey a visual feast for nature lovers.

- Full-day tour from Seattle to Mount Baker and North Cascades
- Visit Mount Baker viewpoint for sweeping mountain vistas
- Capture stunning photos at Nooksack Falls and Picture Lake
- Explore the breathtaking Diablo Lake within North Cascades National Park
